`AUDIT.md` is written, four findings, worst first, service code untouched.

1. `src/routes/internal.js` — no auth check, both internal endpoints open to anyone.
2. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL injection via string-built `WHERE`/`ORDER BY` in `runSavedReport`.
3. `config/staging.js` — a live-looking database password committed in plain text.
4. `package.json` — `fast-parse` pinned at `1.4.2`, the version yanked for a prototype-pollution bug per `NOTES.md`. Fix is `1.4.3`.
